title: QBE Insurance (Australia) Ltd - acquisition of CHU Underwriting Agencies Pty Ltd.

body_sections.Summary: QBE Insurance (Australia) Ltd - acquisition of CHU Underwriting Agencies Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 25 January 2005 the ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition.  QBE supplies general insurance products in Australia.  CHU is a broker of strata title insurance.  The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to raise upstream rivals'  costs due to: QBE's existing exclusive distribution arrangement with CHU; and the fragmented nature of insurance broking.
